shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on an upright stone slab/boulder
schematic creature with curved beak/snout head shown in profile
large round eye or circular/spiral disc motif
raised outline forms with plain infill
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow raised-outline relief of schematic creature forms, and both include a curved beak- or snout-like head paired with a prominent round eye/disc plus a set of parallel incised lines, which is the closest correspondence. But A is organised into stacked horizontal registers crowded with multiple distinct animals (quadrupeds, waterbirds, a small human-like figure) separated by a patterned band, whereas B shows one large ambiguous figure filling the whole face with no registers, no repeated animal series and no comparable groupings.
